title: Club Merch
lead: Merch for Hofstra SHPE and Hofstra AIAA. Members vote, people preorder, and the club keeps the money. Nothing's on sale yet.
body:
How it's going to work

  1. Members vote on the designs.
  2. The club gets it approved by Hofstra. Anything with a Hofstra club's name on it needs written approval before it goes to a vendor (Hofstra licensing, request form).
  3. We open a preorder page on Custom Ink Fundraising for about two weeks. The club doesn't pay anything upfront (Custom Ink).
  4. If enough people order, it gets printed. If not, everyone gets refunded and nothing gets made (Custom Ink).

Where the money goes

To the club. Each club sets up its own preorder page. Vnua Apparel just shows the designs and doesn't take a cut.

Want one? Email me with your club, the piece and your size so we know how many to plan for.
